t2.title: Our living environment affect our mood and productivity
t2.prompt: A student magazine announced an article writing contest. The best ones will be published in the magazine. Write your article on this topic: "Does our living environment affect our mood and productivity?" Write 180–200 words, giving reasons and examples.
t2.sample:
Our living environment surrounds us daily. I firmly believe it has significant effects on both mood and productivity.

Firstly, natural light dramatically affects wellbeing. Studies show people in well-lit spaces report higher energy levels and better mood. Dark, cramped environments contribute to depression and fatigue.

Secondly, clutter and organization impact focus. A messy environment creates mental distraction, while organized spaces promote clarity and efficiency. This is why productive people often maintain tidy workspaces.

However, individual preferences vary. Some people thrive in minimalist spaces, while others find them cold and uninspiring. Personal taste should guide design choices.

Nevertheless, certain elements are universally beneficial. Indoor plants reduce stress and purify air. Color psychology suggests blues promote calm while yellows encourage creativity.

Furthermore, ergonomic furniture prevents physical discomfort that can distract from work and harm long-term health.

In conclusion, our environment profoundly shapes our mental state. Investing in our living and working spaces is investing in ourselves.
t2.sampleA1:
Hi!
My room is nice. I like blue. Blue is happy. My room is clean. Clean is good. I like my room. I work in my room. Bye!
t2.sampleA2:
Hello,
I think my room is important. Because my room is where I live and work. When my room is messy, I am sad. But when my room is clean, I am happy. I like my room to be bright because the sun makes me happy. I like plants in my room too, because they are green and green is good. So, yes, my room is important for me!
t2.sampleB1:
Hello,
I think our living environment definitely affects how we feel and how well we work. For example, if my room is dark and messy, I feel tired and I can't concentrate. But if my room is bright and tidy, I feel much better and I can do my work easily.

Also, I think the colours in our environment are important. For example, bright colours can make us feel more energetic, while calm colours can help us to relax. So, it's important to choose colours that make us feel good.

In conclusion, I believe that our living environment has a big impact on our mood and productivity. We should try to make our homes and workplaces as comfortable and inspiring as possible.
t2.sampleB2: Have you ever noticed how a cluttered, dim room can drain your energy in minutes? It's no coincidence. Where we live and work shapes our mood and productivity far more than we tend to realise. Firstly, natural light makes a huge difference. A room bathed in sunlight lifts your spirits and helps you stay focused, while a dark, stuffy space weighs you down and leaves you feeling sluggish. Secondly, tidiness matters. When my desk is a mess, my mind feels the same way, and getting anything done becomes an uphill battle. A neat, well-organised space, on the other hand, clears your head and lets you get on with the task at hand. Colour and greenery play their part too. Soft, warm tones create a calming atmosphere, whereas harsh lighting can make you feel tense and on edge. Even a few indoor plants can breathe life into a dull corner and make a room feel fresh. All things considered, our surroundings are not just a backdrop – they set the tone for how we feel and how much we get done. Making a little effort to brighten up our space really does pay off in the long run.
t2.uzSample:
Bizning yashash muhitimiz har kuni bizni o'rab turadi. Men uning kayfiyat va unumdorlikka sezilarli ta'siri borligiga qat'iy ishonaman.

Birinchidan, tabiiy yorug'lik farovonlikka keskin ta'sir qiladi. Tadqiqotlar shuni ko'rsatadiki, yaxshi yoritilgan joylarda odamlar yuqori energiya darajasi va yaxshi kayfiyat haqida xabar berishadi. Qorong'i, tor muhitlar depressiya va charchoqqa olib keladi.

Ikkinchidan, tartibsizlik va tashkilotchilik diqqatni jamlashga ta'sir qiladi. Tartibsiz muhit aqliy chalg'itishni yaratadi, tartibli joylar esa aniqlik va samaradorlikni oshiradi. Shuning uchun ham unumdor odamlar ko'pincha ozoda ish joylarini saqlashadi.

Biroq, individual xohishlar har xil bo'ladi. Ba'zi odamlar minimalist joylarda gullab-yashnashadi, boshqalar esa ularni sovuq va ilhomlantirmaydigan deb bilishadi. Shaxsiy did dizayn tanlovlariga yo'nalish berishi kerak.

Shunga qaramay, ba'zi elementlar universal tarzda foydalidir. Xona o'simliklari stressni kamaytiradi va havoni tozalaydi. Rang psixologiyasi ko'klar xotirjamlikni, sarig'lar esa ijodkorlikni rag'batlantirishini ko'rsatadi.

Bundan tashqari, ergonomik mebel ishdan chalg'itishi va uzoq muddatli sog'liqqa zarar etkazishi mumkin bo'lgan jismoniy noqulaylikning oldini oladi.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, bizning muhitimiz aqliy holatimizni chuqur shakllantiradi. Yashash va ish joylarimizga sarmoya kiritish o'zimizga sarmoya kiritishdir.
t2.uzSampleA1:
Salom!
Mening xonam yaxshi. Menga ko'k rang yoqadi. Ko'k rang xursandchilik keltiradi. Mening xonam toza. Tozalik yaxshi. Menga o'z xonam yoqadi. Men o'z xonamda ishlayman. Xayr!
t2.uzSampleA2:
Salom,
Menimcha, mening xonam muhim. Chunki mening xonam - bu men yashaydigan va ishlaydigan joy. Xonam tartibsiz bo'lsa, men xafa bo'laman. Ammo xonam toza bo'lsa, men xursand bo'laman. Xonamning yorug' bo'lishini yaxshi ko'raman, chunki quyosh meni xursand qiladi. Xonamda o'simliklar bo'lishini ham yaxshi ko'raman, chunki ular yashil va yashil rang yaxshi. Shunday qilib, ha, mening xonam men uchun muhim!
t2.uzSampleB1:
Salom,
Menimcha, yashash muhitimiz bizning qanday his qilishimizga va qanchalik yaxshi ishlashimizga albatta ta'sir qiladi. Misol uchun, agar xonam qorong'i va tartibsiz bo'lsa, o'zimni charchagan his qilaman va diqqatimni jamlay olmayman. Ammo agar xonam yorug' va toza bo'lsa, o'zimni ancha yaxshi his qilaman va ishimni osonlik bilan bajara olaman.

Shuningdek, menimcha, atrofimizdagi ranglar ham muhim. Misol uchun, yorqin ranglar bizni yanada tetik his qilishimizga yordam berishi mumkin, sokin ranglar esa dam olishimizga yordam beradi. Shunday ekan, o'zimizni yaxshi his qiladigan ranglarni tanlash muhim.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, menimcha, yashash muhitimiz kayfiyatimiz va unumdorligimizga katta ta'sir ko'rsatadi. Uylarimiz va ish joylarimizni imkon qadar qulay va ilhomlantiruvchi qilishga harakat qilishimiz kerak.
t2.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli jurnal muharriri,
Men yashash muhitimiz kayfiyatimiz va unumdorligimizga qanday ta'sir qilishi haqida o'z fikrlarimni baham ko'rish uchun yozyapman. Menimcha, bu bog'liqlik inkor etib bo'lmaydigan va juda muhimdir.

Birinchidan, tabiiy yorug'likning ta'sirini ko'rib chiqing. Quyosh nuri bilan to'ldirilgan joylar ko'proq ijobiy va energetik muhitni yaratishga moyil bo'ladi, bu esa tabiiy ravishda kayfiyatning yaxshilanishiga va unumdorlikning oshishiga olib keladi. Aksincha, xira yoritilgan yoki yomon shamollatiladigan joylar dangasalik hissi va diqqatning pasayishiga olib kelishi mumkin.

Ikkinchidan, yashash joyimizdagi tartib, yoki uning yo'qligi muhim rol o'ynaydi. Tartibsiz muhit haddan tashqari yuklanganlik va aqliy chalg'itish hissini yaratishi mumkin, bu esa diqqatni jamlash va vazifalarni samarali bajarish qobiliyatimizga to'sqinlik qiladi. Yaxshi tashkil etilgan joy, aksincha, aniqlikni ta'minlaydi va yanada soddalashtirilgan ish jarayonini ta'minlaydi.

Bundan tashqari, atrofimizdagi estetik elementlar, masalan, rang sxemalari va dekor ham bizning hissiy holatimizga va kognitiv faoliyatimizga ta'sir qilishi mumkin. Ma'lum ranglar muayyan his-tuyg'ularni uyg'otishi ma'lum va o'ylab topilgan dizayndagi joy ijodkorlik va motivatsiyani ilhomlantirishi mumkin.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, men yashash muhitimiz kayfiyatimiz va unumdorligimizning kuchli omili ekanligiga qat'iy ishonaman. Atrofimizni farovonlik va samaradorlikka yordam beradigan tarzda ongli ravishda shakllantirish orqali biz hayot sifatini sezilarli darajada yaxshilashimiz mumkin.

Hurmat bilan,
Akmal Nazarov

t11.prompt: Write a letter to your friend, who just bought a new house and doesn't know how to decorate it. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the interior design service. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample: Dear StyleSpace Team, Thank you for asking about my experience with your interior design service. I am absolutely delighted with the transformation. Your designer perfectly understood my vision and created a space that feels both stylish and comfortable. The attention to detail was impressive, and the project was completed on schedule. However, I have some suggestions. The initial consultation fee wasn't clearly explained upfront. Additionally, some furniture deliveries arrived later than expected. I would appreciate virtual design services for clients who prefer remote consultations. Budget-friendly packages would attract younger homeowners. Also, offering sustainable design options with eco-friendly materials would be valuable. Overall, StyleSpace exceeded my expectations. Yours sincerely, Akmal Nazarov
t12.sampleA1:
Hi StyleSpace,


Thank you. My living room is good. I like the blue color. The sofa is nice. Good job!


Bye.
t12.sampleA2:
Dear StyleSpace Team,


Thank you for my living room. It is very nice. I like the new sofa and the paint. It is very beautiful. But the lights are not good. I want different lights. And the rug is too small. I want a bigger rug. Thank you for your help.


Bye,


Akmal Nazarov
t12.sampleB1:
Dear StyleSpace Team,


Thank you for your email. I am writing to tell you about my experience with your service. I am happy with my new living room. It looks very good, and the designer listened to what I wanted.


However, there are a few things I think you could improve. For example, it was difficult to contact the designer sometimes. Also, I think you should offer more options for different budgets. It would be good to have some cheaper choices.


In the future, maybe you could offer a service where people can see what the room will look like before you start the work. Overall, I am pleased, but there are some things to think about.


Sincerely,


Akmal Nazarov
t12.sampleB2: Dear StyleSpace Team, Thank you for getting in touch about the recent makeover of my living room. I'm writing to share some honest feedback. On the whole, I'm thrilled with the result. Your designer really took the time to understand what I wanted, and the attention to detail blew me away. The room feels bright, warm and completely my own. That said, there's room for improvement. The delivery of the furniture ran behind schedule, and I wasn't kept in the loop about the delays, which was a little frustrating at the time. Going forward, it would be great to see budget-friendly packages for younger clients, as well as more eco-friendly materials on offer. A virtual consultation option for people who live further away would be a lovely touch too. Overall, though, you exceeded my expectations, and I wouldn't hesitate to recommend you to friends and family. Yours sincerely, Bekzod Aliyev

Biroq, menda ba'zi takliflar bor. Dastlabki maslahat uchun to'lov oldindan aniq tushuntirilmagan edi. Bundan tashqari, ba'zi mebel yetkazib berishlari kutilganidan kechroq keldi.

Men masofaviy maslahatlarni afzal ko'rgan mijozlar uchun virtual dizayn xizmatlarini qadrlagan bo'lardim. Arzon paketlar yosh uy egalarini jalb qiladi. Shuningdek, ekologik toza materiallar bilan barqaror dizayn variantlarini taklif qilish qimmatli bo'ladi.

Umuman olganda, StyleSpace mening kutganimdan ham oshib ketdi.

Hurmat bilan,
Akmal Nazarov

Biroq, yaxshilanishi mumkin bo'lgan bir nechta sohalar mavjud. Birinchidan, loyiha muddati haqidagi aloqa aniqroq bo'lishi mumkin edi. Yetkazib berish va o'rnatish jadvali haqida ishonchsizlik bo'lgan bir nechta holatlar bo'ldi. Ikkinchidan, materiallarning sifati juda yaxshi bo'lsa-da, menimcha, barqaror va ekologik toza variantlarning kengroq assortimentini taklif qilish foydali bo'ladi, ayniqsa atrof-muhitga e'tiborli mijozlar uchun.


Kelajakka nazar tashlasak, ehtimol siz interyer dizayni tamoyillari bo'yicha seminar yoki onlayn darsliklar taklif qilishingiz mumkin. Bu yangi mijozlarni jalb qilishi va "StyleSpace"ni sohada yetakchi sifatida ko'rsatishi mumkin. Umuman olganda, men xizmatdan mamnunman va "StyleSpace"ni boshqalarga tavsiya qilaman.


Hurmat bilan,


Akmal Nazarov
